parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
For one specific phobia:
Identify two characteristics of this phobia.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe the psychoanalytic explanation of phobias (Freud, 1909).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain one strength and one weakness of the psychoanalytic explanation of phobias.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the treatment and management of obsessive-compulsive and related disorders.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate the treatment and management of obsessive-compulsive and related disorders,
including a discussion about reductionism versus holism. 
Psychology and consumer behaviour

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Vrechopoulos (2004) investigated virtual interior layouts of grocery stores.
Outline the ‘grid’ store layout. You may include a diagram in your answer.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe the study by Guéguen et al. (2007) on music in open air markets.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain two strengths of the study by Guéguen et al.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about ‘buying the product’ (theory of planned
behaviour, black box model, consumer decision model).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about ‘buying the product’ (theory of planned
behaviour, black box model, consumer decision model), including a discussion about practical
applications. 
Psychology and health

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by ‘organic pain’.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: The Wong-Baker rating scale is a measure of children’s pain.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Outline the Wong-Baker rating scale. You may include a diagram in your answer.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Explain how this scale is used to measure children’s pain.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
One difference between the Wong-Baker scale and the McGill pain questionnaire is whether
they are used with children or adults.
Explain two other differences between these pain measures.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about health promotion in schools, worksites
and communities.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about health promotion in schools, worksites
and communities, including a discussion of the longitudinal research method. 
Psychology and organisations

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Group decision-making can lead to cognitive limitations and errors including sins of
commission, sins of omission and sins of imprecision (Forsyth, 2006).
Explain what is meant by ‘sins of commission’.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe Belbin’s theory of team roles.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain one strength and one weakness of Belbin’s theory of team roles.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about traditional and modern theories of
leadership (universalist and behavioural theories, adaptive leadership, three levels of
leadership).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about traditional and modern theories of
leadership (universalist and behavioural theories, adaptive leadership, three levels of
leadership), including a discussion about determinism versus free-will.
